entries.def: (= the reason for the meeting is ...)
entries.example: The purpose of the meeting is to plan the timetable.
We'll be late unless we leave now.
Unless the weather improves, we won't be able to go.
I have to go now, otherwise I'll miss the last bus.
You'll have to turn up the music, otherwise they won't be able to hear it.

entries.def: (= but you must bring it back)
entries.example: You can borrow it as long as you bring it back by Thursday.
You can wear what you like as long as you look smart.

note: Unit 42 presentation is explanatory prose (sections A Reason, B Purpose, C Result, D Condition), not a word table. Only items with printed bracket glosses '(= ...)' are extracted as entries; prose explanations without a headword+gloss format are not listed. Right page is exercises and was excluded.
